reason: The hypothesis transfers the reactive element effect (Y doping) from conventional superalloys (P38, P41) to a specific CrFeCoNiAl HEA system processed by MA+SPS, proposing a new mechanism of Y-rich oxide dispersoids pinning the interface to alleviate stress and prevent spallation. No passage studies Y in this HEA composition or processing route, and the controlled comparison against Si/Mn variants is a novel integration.
